blocks.text: 9-darsda **have / have got** ni egalik ma'nosida o'rgandik: I **have** a car = I**'ve got** a car — «Mashinam bor». Bu darsda **have** boshqa vazifada: u **harakatni** bildiradi va o'zbekchada «qilmoq», «ichmoq», «yemoq», «o'tkazmoq», «qabul qilmoq» kabi fe'llar bilan tarjima qilinadi: have **breakfast** — nonushta qilmoq, have **a shower** — dush qabul qilmoq, have **a good time** — vaqtni yaxshi o'tkazmoq. Bunday iboralarda **have got** ishlatilmaydi, **Continuous** esa mumkin: I**'m having** lunch.

rows: I **have** a car. = I**'ve got** a car.
Do you have ...? / Have you got ...?
faqat do / does / did: **Did** you **have** a good time?

blocks.text: Ovqatlanish haqida gapirganda inglizlar ko'pincha **eat** yoki **drink** emas, **have** deydi: have **breakfast / lunch / dinner** (artiklsiz!), have **a meal**, have **a coffee / a cup of tea / a drink**, have **something to eat**. O'zbekchada «nonushta qilmoq», «tushlik qilmoq», «choy ichmoq». Kafeda buyurtma berganda ham have: I**'ll have** the soup, please — «Menga sho'rva bering».

items.text: I**'ll have** a green tea, please.

blocks.text: have **a shower** / **a bath** — dush qabul qilmoq / vannada cho'milmoq, have **a wash** — yuvinmoq, have **a rest** — dam olmoq, have **a break** — tanaffus qilmoq, have **a holiday** — ta'tilga chiqmoq, dam olmoq, have **a nap** — biroz uxlab olmoq. Amerikancha **take** a shower / take a break ham ko'p eshitiladi, lekin Britaniyada **have** odatiyroq.

items.text: I'm tired. I need to **have a rest**.
After the gym I always **have a shower**.
items.translation: Sport zalidan keyin doim **dush qabul qilaman**.

blocks.text: have **a good / great / nice / terrible time** — vaqtni yaxshi / ajoyib / yomon o'tkazmoq, have **fun** — maza qilmoq, have **a party** — ziyofat qilmoq (make a party emas!), have **a good trip** — yaxshi borib kelmoq. Tilaklar buyruq shaklida aytiladi (35-dars): **Have a nice day!** — «Kuningiz xayrli o'tsin!», **Have a good trip!** — «Oq yo'l!», **Have fun!** — «Maza qiling!»

items.text: **Have a nice day!** — Thanks, you too.
The kids **had fun** in the snow.

blocks.text: have bilan yana ko'p kundalik iboralar bor. Ularning hammasida have — harakat yoki voqea, egalik emas. O'zbekchada har biri o'z fe'li bilan tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun ularni tayyor holda yodlang.

items.text: Let me **have a look** at your homework.
We **had a long chat** on the phone.

blocks.text: Bu iboralarda have — **harakat**, shuning uchun Present Continuous va Past Continuous da ishlatiladi (3, 13-darslar): I**'m having** lunch — «tushlik qilyapman», We **were having** dinner when ... — «kechki ovqat qilayotgan edik». Egalik ma'nosidagi have esa Continuous da kelmaydi (8-dars): «I'm having a car» — xato, to'g'risi: I **have** a car. Bir gapda ikkalasi: I **have** two sisters, and they**'re having** a party tonight.

items.text: When you called, I **was having** a bath.
items.translation: Siz qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda men **vannada cho'milayotgan edim**.

blocks.text: 6. Savol va inkor: do / does / did

Harakat ma'nosidagi have oddiy fe'l kabi ishlaydi: savol va inkor **do / does / did** bilan yasaladi: **Did** you **have** a good time? — «Yaxshi dam oldingizmi?»; I **don't have** breakfast — «Nonushta qilmayman». «Had you a good time?» yoki «I haven't breakfast» — xato. Present Perfect da have ikki marta keladi: I **haven't had** lunch yet — birinchisi yordamchi fe'l, ikkinchisi asosiy fe'l (V3).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'm having a car.» → **I have a car.** (egalik — Continuous yo'q); «I've got a shower every morning.» → **I have a shower every morning.** (harakat — have got yo'q); «Had you a good weekend?» → **Did you have a good weekend?**; «make a party» → **have a party**; «spend a good time» → **have a good time**; «I have 20 years.» → **I'm 20.** (yosh — have emas, **be** bilan, 1-dars).

Eslab qolish: o'zbekchada **qilmoq / ichmoq / o'tkazmoq / qabul qilmoq** bilan aytiladigan kundalik harakatlarning ko'pi inglizchada **have** bilan: nonushta qilmoq — have breakfast, dush qabul qilmoq — have a shower, vaqtni yaxshi o'tkazmoq — have a good time. have harakat bo'lsa — have got ishlatmang, Continuous esa mumkin.

examples.title: **have** breakfast, **have** lunch, **have** dinner
examples.description: Ovqatlanish — have + breakfast / lunch / dinner (artiklsiz): have breakfast — nonushta qilmoq. O'zbekchadagi «qilmoq» o'rniga have.

sentences.text: We usually **have breakfast** at half past seven.
sentences.translation: Odatda soat yetti yarimda **nonushta qilamiz**.

sentences.text: What time do you **have lunch** at work?
sentences.translation: Ishda soat nechada **tushlik qilasiz**?

sentences.text: Last night we **had dinner** at a Turkish restaurant.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun turk restoranida **kechki ovqat qildik**.

sentences.text: Aziz never **has breakfast** — he just drinks a cup of tea.
sentences.translation: Aziz hech qachon **nonushta qilmaydi** — shunchaki bir piyola choy ichadi.

sentences.text: On Fridays the whole family **has lunch** at Grandma's house.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari butun oila buvimnikida **tushlik qiladi**.

sentences.text: Let's **have** a quick **meal** before the film starts.
sentences.translation: Film boshlanishidan oldin tezgina **ovqatlanib olaylik**.

sentences.text: Emma only **had** a sandwich **for lunch** today.
sentences.translation: Emma bugun **tushlikka** faqat sendvich **yedi**.

sentences.text: Sarah and James **had** a romantic **dinner** on their anniversary.
sentences.translation: Sara va Jeyms to'y yilligida romantik **kechki ovqat qilishdi**.

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan people often **have plov** on special occasions.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda odamlar ko'pincha bayram kunlari **palov yeyishadi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **had** a big **lunch**, so he isn't hungry now.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tushlikda **ko'p ovqat yedi**, shuning uchun hozir qorni och emas.

examples.title: **have** a coffee, **have** a drink, **have** something to eat
examples.description: Ichish va yeyish: have a coffee / a cup of tea / a drink / a glass of water / something to eat / a piece of cake. O'zbekchada «ichmoq», «yemoq».

sentences.text: Would you like to **have a coffee** with me?
sentences.translation: Men bilan **qahva ichishni** xohlaysizmi?

sentences.text: I**'ll have** a cup of tea, please.
sentences.translation: Menga bir piyola **choy bering**, iltimos.

sentences.text: Shall we stop and **have something to eat**?
sentences.translation: To'xtab, **biror narsa yeb olaylikmi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **had** a glass of cold **water** after her run.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yugurgandan keyin bir stakan sovuq **suv ichdi**.

sentences.text: **Have a piece of cake** — I made it myself!
sentences.translation: Bir bo'lak **tort oling** — o'zim pishirdim!

sentences.text: We **had a drink** in a small café near the river.
sentences.translation: Daryo yaqinidagi kichik kafeda **biror narsa ichdik**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **has** green **tea** with every meal.
sentences.translation: Buvim har ovqatdan keyin **ko'k choy ichadi**.

sentences.text: Tom **didn't have** anything to drink all day, so he felt ill.
sentences.translation: Tom butun kun **hech narsa ichmadi**, shuning uchun o'zini yomon his qildi.

sentences.text: What **would** you **like to have**? — Just an orange juice, thanks.
sentences.translation: Nima **ichasiz**? — Faqat apelsin sharbati, rahmat.

sentences.text: At eleven Madina and her colleagues usually **have coffee** and biscuits in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Soat o'n birda Madina va hamkasblari odatda oshxonada pechenye bilan **qahva ichishadi**.

examples.title: **have** a shower, **have** a rest, **have** a holiday
examples.description: Yuvinish va dam olish: have a shower / a bath, have a wash, have a rest (dam olmoq), have a break (tanaffus qilmoq), have a holiday (ta'tilga chiqmoq), have a nap (biroz uxlab olmoq).

sentences.text: I **have a shower** every morning before work.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab ishdan oldin **dush qabul qilaman**.

sentences.text: You look tired. Why don't you **have a rest**?
sentences.translation: Charchagan ko'rinasiz. Nega **dam olmaysiz**?

sentences.text: The children **had a bath** and went to bed.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **cho'milishdi** va uxlashga yotishdi.

sentences.text: Let's **have a break** for ten minutes.
sentences.translation: O'n daqiqa **tanaffus qilaylik**.

sentences.text: We **had** a wonderful **holiday** in Turkey last year.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Turkiyada ajoyib **dam oldik**.

sentences.text: After the long journey, Bekzod **had a wash** and changed his clothes.
sentences.translation: Uzoq yo'ldan keyin Bekzod **yuvinib oldi** va kiyimini almashtirdi.

sentences.text: My grandfather **has a nap** after lunch every day.
sentences.translation: Bobom har kuni tushlikdan keyin **biroz uxlab oladi**.

sentences.text: When did you last **have a holiday**? — Two years ago!
sentences.translation: Oxirgi marta qachon **ta'tilga chiqqansiz**? — Ikki yil oldin!

sentences.text: In hot weather I sometimes **have** two **showers** a day.
sentences.translation: Issiq havoda ba'zan kuniga ikki marta **dush qabul qilaman**.

sentences.text: Our teacher lets us **have a short break** in the middle of the lesson.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz dars o'rtasida bizga qisqa **tanaffus qilishga** ruxsat beradi.

examples.title: **have** a good time, **have** a party, **have** fun
examples.description: Vaqtni qanday o'tkazish: have a good / great / terrible time, have fun (maza qilmoq), have a party (ziyofat qilmoq). Tilaklar: Have a nice weekend! Have a good trip!

sentences.text: **Have a nice** weekend! — Thanks, you too.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlarini **yaxshi o'tkazing**! — Rahmat, sizga ham.

sentences.text: We **had a great time** at Madina's wedding.
sentences.translation: Madinaning to'yida **ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik**.

sentences.text: Are you **having a party** for your birthday?
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningizga **ziyofat qilasizmi**?

sentences.text: The kids **had** a lot of **fun** at the water park.
sentences.translation: Bolalar suv parkida rosa **maza qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Did you **have a good time** in London? — Yes, it was amazing.
sentences.translation: Londonda **yaxshi dam oldingizmi**? — Ha, juda ajoyib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Have a good trip**, and call us when you arrive!
sentences.translation: **Oq yo'l**, yetib borganingizda qo'ng'iroq qiling!

sentences.text: Our neighbours **had** a noisy **party** until three in the morning.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz tungi soat uchgacha shovqinli **ziyofat qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, James **had a terrible time** at the dentist.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, Jeyms tish shifokorida juda **qiynaldi**.

sentences.text: Every year the company **has a big party** for its workers.
sentences.translation: Har yili kompaniya xodimlari uchun katta **ziyofat o'tkazadi**.

sentences.text: I hope you **have a wonderful** birthday, Dilnoza!
sentences.translation: Dilnoza, tug'ilgan kuningiz **ajoyib o'tsin**!

examples.title: **have** a look, **have** a chat, **have** a baby
examples.description: Boshqa muhim iboralar: have a look (qarab ko'rmoq), have a chat / a talk (suhbatlashmoq), have a baby (farzand ko'rmoq), have an accident (avariyaga uchramoq), have a dream (tush ko'rmoq), have a go (urinib ko'rmoq).

sentences.text: Can I **have a look** at your photos?
sentences.translation: Suratlaringizni **ko'rib chiqsam** maylimi?

sentences.text: My sister **had a baby** last week — a little girl!
sentences.translation: Opam o'tgan hafta **farzand ko'rdi** — qizcha!

sentences.text: Aziz **had an accident** on his way to work, but he's OK.
sentences.translation: Aziz ishga ketayotganda **avariyaga uchradi**, lekin u yaxshi.

sentences.text: I **had** a strange **dream** last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi g'alati **tush ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: Let's **have a chat** over coffee tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ertaga qahva ustida **gaplashib olaylik**.

sentences.text: This puzzle is hard. Do you want to **have a go**?
sentences.translation: Bu boshqotirma qiyin. **Urinib ko'rasizmi**?

sentences.text: The mechanic **had a look** at my car and found the problem.
sentences.translation: Usta mashinamni **ko'rib chiqdi** va muammoni topdi.

sentences.text: Sarah and her boss **had a long talk** about her future.
sentences.translation: Sara va boshlig'i uning kelajagi haqida uzoq **suhbatlashishdi**.

sentences.text: Have you ever **had an argument** with your best friend?
sentences.translation: Hech eng yaqin do'stingiz bilan **janjallashganmisiz**?

sentences.text: Bekzod didn't know the answer, so he **had a guess** — and he was right!
sentences.translation: Bekzod javobni bilmasdi, shuning uchun **taxmin qildi** — va to'g'ri chiqdi!

examples.title: Continuous: **I'm having** lunch
examples.description: Bu iboralarda have — harakat, shuning uchun Continuous da ishlatiladi: I'm having lunch — «tushlik qilyapman». Egalik ma'nosidagi have (I have a car) esa Continuous da kelmaydi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I can't talk now — I**'m having** lunch.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hozir gaplasha olmayman — **tushlik qilyapman**.

sentences.text: Where's Emma? — She**'s having** a shower.
sentences.translation: Emma qayerda? — **Dush qabul qilyapti**.

sentences.text: We**'re having** a great time in Samarkand!
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **ajoyib dam olyapmiz**!

sentences.text: The students **are having** a break in the garden.
sentences.translation: Talabalar bog'da **tanaffus qilishyapti**.

sentences.text: When I called, my parents **were having** dinner.
sentences.translation: Men qo'ng'iroq qilganimda ota-onam **kechki ovqat qilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Tom **is having** problems with his new phone.
sentences.translation: Tom yangi telefoni bilan **muammoga duch kelyapti**.

sentences.text: I **have** two brothers, and they**'re having** a party tonight.
sentences.translation: Mening ikkita **akam bor**, ular bugun kechqurun **ziyofat qilishyapti**.

sentences.text: Are you **having** a good holiday? — Yes, the weather is perfect.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilingiz **yaxshi o'tyaptimi**? — Ha, havo zo'r.

sentences.text: Madina **has** a big flat, and this week she**'s having** guests from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Madinaning katta **kvartirasi bor**, bu hafta uning uyida Buxorodan **mehmonlar turibdi**.

sentences.text: James wasn't at the meeting because he **was having** a medical check-up.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yig'ilishda yo'q edi, chunki u **tibbiy ko'rikdan o'tayotgan edi**.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: **did** you **have** ...?
examples.description: Bu iboralarda savol va inkor do / does / did bilan quriladi: Did you have a good time? — «Had you ...?» emas. Qisqa javob: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

sentences.text: **Did** you **have** a good weekend? — Yes, I did, thanks.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari **yaxshi o'tdimi**? — Ha, rahmat.

sentences.text: I **didn't have** breakfast this morning, so I'm starving.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **nonushta qilmadim**, shuning uchun qornim juda och.

sentences.text: **Do** you usually **have** lunch at your desk? — No, I go to a café.
sentences.translation: Odatda ish stolingizda **tushlik qilasizmi**? — Yo'q, kafega boraman.

sentences.text: My father **doesn't have** coffee after six — he can't sleep.
sentences.translation: Dadam soat oltidan keyin **qahva ichmaydi** — uxlay olmay qoladi.

sentences.text: **Did** Bekzod **have** an accident? — No, he didn't. His car just broke down.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **avariyaga uchradimi**? — Yo'q. Mashinasi shunchaki buzilib qoldi.

sentences.text: We **didn't have** a holiday last year because we were moving house.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili **ta'tilga chiqmadik**, chunki uy ko'chayotgan edik.

sentences.text: What time **does** Dilnoza **have** her English lesson? — At four.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning ingliz tili **darsi** soat nechada **bo'ladi**? — To'rtda.

sentences.text: Why **didn't** you **have** a rest? You look exhausted.
sentences.translation: Nega **dam olmadingiz**? Juda charchagan ko'rinasiz.

sentences.text: **Did** the children **have** fun at the zoo? — They loved it!
sentences.translation: Bolalar hayvonot bog'ida **maza qilishdimi**? — Juda yoqdi!

sentences.text: Emma **hasn't had** a day off for weeks, so she's very tired.
sentences.translation: Emma necha haftadan beri bir kun ham **dam olmagan**, shuning uchun juda charchagan.

examples.title: Dialogue: a phone call from holiday
examples.description: Suhbatda have iboralari aralash: have a wonderful time, have a good journey, have a problem, have an accident, have dinner, have a shower, have a look, have fun.

sentences.text: — Hi, Mum! We**'re having** a wonderful time in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: — Salom, oyi! Buxoroda **ajoyib dam olyapmiz**.

sentences.text: — That's great! **Did** you **have** a good journey?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Yo'lda **yaxshi keldingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, but we **had** a small problem with the car.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin mashina bilan kichik **muammo bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! **Did** you **have** an accident?
sentences.translation: — Voy! **Avariyaga uchradingizmi**?

sentences.text: — No, don't worry, we just **had** a flat tyre.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, xavotir olmang, shunchaki g'ildirak **teshilib qoldi**.

sentences.text: — I see. **Are** you **having** dinner now?
sentences.translation: — Tushunarli. Hozir **kechki ovqat qilyapsizlarmi**?

sentences.text: — Not yet. The children **are having** a shower, and then we're going out.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. Bolalar **dush qabul qilishyapti**, keyin tashqariga chiqamiz.

sentences.text: — **Have** a look at the old market — it's beautiful in the evening.
sentences.translation: — Eski bozorni **aylanib ko'ringlar** — kechqurun juda chiroyli bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — We will. Tomorrow we**'re having** lunch with Aunt Lola.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Ertaga Lola xola bilan **tushlik qilamiz**.

sentences.text: — Lovely! **Have** fun, and give her my love.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! **Maza qilinglar**, unga mendan salom aytinglar.
